items.note: ⚠ old OCR. Pañcacāmara type of prāsāda: a Śṛṅga with kalaśa-aṇḍaka, twenty śikharas combined with all maṇḍapas
items.gloss: By pada triad may be the śṛṅga over that, with kalaśa and aṇḍaka; twenty śikharas deserve to be created combined with all maṇḍapas (pavilions).

items.note: ⚠ old OCR. Mahāghoṣa prāsāda: śṛṅgas at the karṇa on the first storey, a second storey without wall, a third storey with four columns
items.gloss: One may create śṛṅgas at the karṇa; this becomes the first storey; the second is to be made without the wall enclosure; on four sides vedī and candrāvalokana, and the third storey also one may make with four columns.
